create.name: Janet Stone
create.bio:
Janet Stone is a San Francisco yoga teacher whose path began with meditation. She grew up on rural land in Northern California, danced through her teens and met her meditation teacher, Prem Rawat, at seventeen. After years working in film and television production in Los Angeles, she travelled to India in 1996, her grandfather's birthplace, and committed herself to yoga. She has now been teaching for more than two decades.

Her classes join a creative, flowing vinyasa with the eight limbs of yoga, pranayama, meditation and bhakti, the devotional yoga of chanting and mantra, and she often teaches alongside live music from her partner, the producer DJ Drez, and she has released three albums of devotional mantra. Through Stone Yoga School she runs 200-hour, 300-hour and longer teacher trainings in hybrid and online formats, and she offers PRACTICE*365, an online membership with live and recorded classes. She teaches regular public classes in San Francisco and leads retreats and immersions at Esalen, in Mexico, in the Columbia River Gorge and in India, as well as a six-month mentoring programme. Her book Stories of Our Lives retells sacred Indian myths as maps for everyday life, and she has recorded a ten-day course on deep rest for Commune.

books.title: Stories of Our Lives: Awakened Living Through Sacred Mythology
books.author: Janet Stone
books.description: Janet retells classic stories from the Indian tradition, such as those of Hanuman, Durga and Lakshmi, alongside personal reflection and the hero's-journey pattern described by Joseph Campbell. Each story comes with practices, mantras and questions for seeing these myths at work in ordinary life.

courses.title: Coming Home: Journey Into Deep Rest
courses.description: A ten-day Commune course with Janet and DJ Drez of short evening practices: yoga nidra, guided meditation, gentle breathing, a restorative pose and visualisation, each set to an original soundtrack.

courses.title: PRACTICE*365
courses.description: Janet's online membership, with several live classes a month, an archive of nearly 500 recorded practices and community meet-ups. Practices combine postures, mantra, breathing and stillness.

courses.title: Gratitude Retreat
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur of yoga, meditation and reflection on gratitude, with guest teachers and musicians and time for the cliffside baths.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (booked through Esalen; cost depends on room)

courses.title: Giving Thanks • A Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A five-day Thanksgiving-week retreat at Esalen built around the idea of 'enoughness', with daily yoga, meditation and time on the land.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (booked through Esalen; cost depends on room)

courses.title: Begin Again: New Years at Haramara
courses.description: A week off-grid at Haramara Retreat near Sayulita, Mexico, to see in the new year. Days hold postures, meditation, breathing and chanting, with plenty of time for the beach and rest.
courses.price: $2,888–$4,388 USD per person by room ($1,208 USD deposit)

courses.title: Begin Again • A Yoga Journey
courses.description: A week of early-morning practice at the Castro Room in San Francisco or online: meditation, breathing, postures, mantra and daily dharma talks to set an intention for the year.

courses.title: Mentorship Program
courses.description: A six-month programme for up to eighteen teachers, leaders and creatives, with monthly online group meetings, one-to-one sessions with Janet, business guidance and a long weekend together in the Columbia River Gorge.

courses.title: Living Bhakti | Intention · Devotion · Alignment
courses.description: A four-day immersion at Columbia Gorge Yoga in White Salmon, Washington, on bhakti as a way of living. It weaves movement, breath, mantra, chanting, myth and intuitive sequencing.

courses.title: 300 hour Residential Training Immersion
courses.description: A three-week residential advanced teacher training in Rishikesh, India, organised around purpose, practice and devotion, for teachers and committed practitioners.

courses.title: Chanting: Yoga of the Heart
courses.description: An online course on bhakti through chanting, teaching traditional mantras along with the myths and deities behind them. It can be taken at your own pace or with the next community group.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (pay in full, instalments or sliding scale)

Several YouTube videos are excerpts or trailers for her paid courses; view counts are low (200–1.6K). Only the 30 most recent uploads were checked.

Her meditation teacher is Prem Rawat ('Maharaji'), a figure some regard as controversial; mentioned by name in the bio as on her site.
